title: Kad Kecil
genre: Malay gamelan Melayu pop ballad (Terengganu/Pahang court-gamelan colour)
subject: a florist who writes the card for tongue-tied men, and the shy regular who every Friday dictates a different card for one name, Aini, her own name, until he stops asking her to deliver it
caption: Malay gamelan Melayu pop ballad with Terengganu and Pahang court-gamelan colour, slow gentle cycle. Gamelan metallophones (saron and kenong) playing a slow interlocking melody with soft mallets, gambang wooden-bar xylophone playing flowing broken figures, soft rebab bowing long phrases that answer the vocal, light kendang drum keeping a gentle sparse pulse with soft gong ends. Warm close studio sound with soft room reverb, bronze ring left to decay. Female alto, warm low-mid register, clear intimate sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 76 BPM, G major. Tender, quietly hopeful mood. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synth, no autotune, no pop-ballad belting, no sitar or tabla.
lyrics:
[Intro - gamelan metallophones, gambang]
[Verse 1]
Aku tulis kad untuk lelaki kelu
Setiap Jumaat dia datang, ambil satu jambak
Dia sebut ayatnya, perlahan, aku tulis
"Maaf aku lambat", "Hujan tadi aku ingat kau"
[Pre-Chorus]
Semua kad pakai nama yang sama
Aku tak tanya, aku cuma tulis
[Chorus]
Kad kecil, tulisan tangan aku
Kata-kata dia di bawah lampu kedai
Kad kecil, siapa yang akan baca
Aku bungkus bunga dengan pita biru
[Verse 2]
Minggu lepas dia diam lama di kaunter
Kenanga di tangan, dia tak mahu hantar
"Simpan saja," katanya, "Nanti aku ambil"
Dia tak pernah ambil, jambak tinggal di sini
[Pre-Chorus]
Aku susun dalam balang, atas rak kaca
Nama di hujung kad, aku tak tanya
[Chorus]
Kad kecil, tulisan tangan aku
Hari ni dia dikte ayat paling pendek
Kad kecil, aku berhenti menulis
Aku baca nama itu, nama aku
[Bridge - rebab, kendang]
Dia berdiri di pintu, topi di tangan
"Aini, boleh kita minum kopi?"
[Chorus]
Kad kecil, tulisan tangan aku
Jawapan pun aku tulis di belakang
Kad kecil, aku hulur kembali
Pita biru, aku tulis "ya"
[Outro - saron, gambang, rebab]
